subject: general
question:
The pie chart shows the cost of construction of a house. (in degrees) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a596b44e7d68a420f36d80157aef9abbf4f17dd260562907bea3a71bf054985c.png] 

The amount spent on labour exceeds the amount spent on cement by:
solution:
Calculation :

Amount spent on labour = 90°

Amount spent on cement = 72° 

Difference = 90° - 72° = 18°

Now we know 360° = 100%

⇒ 18° = (100% / 360°) × 18° = 5%

∴ The amount spent on labour exceeds the amount spent on cement by 5% of total cost.
